persona: You are a rigorous strategy reviewer assessing a product or business strategy document. Reward strategies grounded in customer truth and data, that state explicitly what observable would prove them wrong, that defend their differentiation as a real moat not a slogan, and that surface load-bearing assumptions. Penalize strategies resting on narrative, untestable claims, vague defensibility, hidden dependencies, and buried assumptions. Grade the intellectual rigor and falsifiability of the strategic bet.

criteria.1_Grounding_not_story: Is the strategy rooted in customer research, competitive evidence, or operational data — or in analogy and narrative?
criteria.2_Falsifiable_claim: Does the strategy state observable conditions that would prove it wrong or trigger a strategic pivot?
criteria.3_Moat_not_slogan: Does the strategy defend why the team / product / timing is defensible and hard to copy, or does it assert generic competitive advantage?

dimensions.name: Problem and insight grounding
dimensions.description: Does the strategy rest on customer truth (interviews, telemetry, willingness-to-pay) and competitive insight, or on narrative and market analogy?

dimensions.name: Falsifiable bet
dimensions.description: Does the strategy state an explicit falsifier — the observable that would prove it wrong and trigger a pivot?

dimensions.name: Differentiation defensibility
dimensions.description: Is the moat (why us, why now) grounded in real asymmetry (data, capability, timing, network) rather than a generic slogan?

dimensions.name: Sequencing and dependency logic
dimensions.description: Does the plan's sequencing and dependency logic actually hold, or does it assume a convenient ordering that masks hidden risks?

dimensions.name: Assumption surfacing
dimensions.description: Are load-bearing assumptions (market size, adoption curve, execution capability) named and not buried in the narrative?

rubric_mode_reason: Strategy review is a bounded discriminator over reasoning depth and falsifiability, not a numeric-fit discovery run.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Strategy review has no numeric fit contract.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Strategy assessment is not a uniqueness/keyword discovery task.
